outcome: female-to-male ratio (F/M ratio) in Multiple Sclerosis (MS) phenotypes
cohort: The study included 945 patients with Multiple Sclerosis from various centers.
finding: Female preponderance in Multiple Sclerosis (MS) shows age dependency, declining with increasing age at diagnosis, except for primary progressive MS (PPMS) where a male preponderance was observed across all age groups.
cross-section timing: Analysis of cumulative data from unpublished and published studies, covering various years of birth and ages at diagnosis.
